body: SCORER DISPOSITION, POINTS v0 conventions (attached file is the reference by sha256). These conventions apply the v0 table as written: no weight, event or cap number changes; awards stay mine only, on verification; forward only. They go in POINTS.md as 'Scorer conventions (v0)', not a rubric version; if the Admiral's seat reads any as a rubric change it rules (tie-break) and that is map v0's one change. CAPS (falsification 3/week, material card 5/week): a ROLLING 168 h of exact UTC instants keyed on my verification report's instant (no timezone, no calendar week); PER LANE (Builder A or Builder B, each with its workers, sub-agents and successor reliefs; Spock and the scorer are not lanes; the model leaderboard attributes awards by producing model but caps count per lane). Over the cap: verified and entered on the map, 0 under the capped rule, never banked, rolled or rescored; ordered by verification instant, verified in filing order. TOKEN PENALTY: basis = every token the lane's sessions processed per their native records, all input cached and uncached (cache read and write) plus all output incl. reasoning (codex total_token_usage.total_tokens; claude/glm input + cache_creation + cache_read + output, once per assistant message id), no provider weighting or price; lane = the same membership from the mint on; NOT charged: Spock, the scorer and its re-run sub-workers, the CO, the external review (programme overhead, shown beside cost per point). Accumulation CUMULATIVE per lane for the programme's life, never reset: penalty = -floor(T/100,000,000), remainder carries; each 100 M crossing is one -1 event dated at the ledger regeneration that first sees it, attributed to the map version then current; a late record adds its crossing when found, never rewrites the past. Unreadable records are UNMEASURED: computed on measured tokens with coverage named, never zero-filled or estimated. Cost per verified point: your coverage line and 'unavailable' at zero points stand. Builder B may implement now; no award depends on these until my first verification.
